articles.summary: Houston conference serves as a platform devoted to advancing the field of basic, preclinical, and translational cancer research Kairos Pharma, Ltd. (NYSE American: KAPA), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company addressing drug resistance in cancer, announces that Neil Bhowmick, President and Chief Scientific Officer, presents today on Kairos Pharma’s lead candidate ENV-105 and its interim efficacy results at the United Scientific Group’s 11th International Conference on Cancer Research Drug Development (Cancer RD 2026) in Houston, TX. Kairos Pharma’s current programs with ENV-105, a first-in-class CD105/BMP signaling inhibitor, include a Phase 1 trial in EGFR-driven non-small cell lung cancer and a Phase 2 trial evaluating ENV-105 (carotuximab) in combination with apalutamide in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). articles.summary: Company’s lead candidate ENV-105 has been selected as winner of the Cancer Immunology Solution of the Year Award Kairos Pharma, Ltd. (NYSE American: KAPA), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company targeting drug resistance in cancer, announces that it has been named a winner of the 2026 Biotech Breakthrough Awards in the category of Cancer Immunology Solution of the Year for its work with ENV-105 targeting cancer drug resistance in metastatic prostate cancer and non-small cell lung cancer. Kairos Pharma was recognized for its differentiated approach to targeting the biological mechanisms that allow tumors to evade treatment. Rather than developing standalone therapies, Kairos is advancing resistance-modulating treatments designed to restore and extend the effectiveness of existing cancer therapies. At the center of this strategy is ENV-105 (carotuximab), an investigational neutralizing antibody designed to inhibit pathways involved in cancer stem cells and therapy resistance.
articles.title: Kairos Pharma Recognized by Biotech Breakthrough Awards in Oncology
